content: A degraded case happens if INLINEFORM0 is large enough to cover the entire document, and the mentions used for global features become the same as the previous work, such as BIBREF21 . In experiments, we heuristically found a suitable INLINEFORM1 which is much smaller than the total number of mentions. The benefits of efficiency are in two ways: (i) to decrease time complexity, and (ii) to trim the entity graph into a fixed size of subgraph that facilitates computation acceleration through GPUs and batch techniques, which will be discussed in Section SECREF24 .
